headline: DepEd Postpones Nationwide Active-Threat School Drills to September
seoTitle: DepEd Postpones Active-Threat School Drills to September | FMB News
seoDescription: DepEd postponed the nationwide active-threat school safety drill from August 25 to September as it consolidates expert guidance and responds to weather-related class disruptions.
deck: The education department moved the August 25 nationwide drill to September while it consolidates expert guidance and adjusts to class disruptions caused by bad weather.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Department of Education postponed the nationwide simultaneous school safety drill for active-attack incidents that had been scheduled for August 25, 2026.
DepEd division advisories now place the rescheduled nationwide activity in early September. A Pangasinan division advisory lists September 3 at 9:00 a.m. for the simultaneous conduct.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: DepEd said weather-related suspension of face-to-face classes in several areas contributed to the postponement and that the delay would also allow the agency to consolidate expert opinions and evidence-based practices.

The Philippine Psychiatric Association and the Philippine Society for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry had urged DepEd to defer hyper-realistic violence simulations, warning that such drills can cause psychological harm. The agency is therefore under pressure to keep preparedness measures trauma-informed and age-appropriate.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: School emergency preparedness has to balance speed and realism with student welfare. A drill that teaches clear procedures without unnecessarily frightening learners can strengthen readiness while reducing avoidable psychological risk.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch DepEd for the final national mechanics, the exact September schedule across divisions, and guidance on how schools should conduct active-threat exercises without graphic or theatrical simulations.
